# SiteScore by MAKTECH

> SiteScore is a free website check by MAKTECH, a web development and hosting company in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It answers "Is your website AI agent ready?" with two scores out of 100: AI agent readiness (6 checks based on open standards) and website health (23 checks across security, reliability, email, performance, and search and sharing). Every finding is explained in plain language, and a PDF report is emailed.

Anyone can check any public website at no cost. SiteScore only looks at what any visitor or search engine can already see.
